name: Persistent Momentum
description: Above EMA10 for 20 sessions, EMA20 for 30, or EMA50 for 50; AND 20-session average turnover at least ₹5 Cr.
rules: Above the 10 EMA for 20 days, or the 20 EMA for 30, or the 50 EMA for 50

name: Easy Money
description: Any one outlier reading: a timeframe return, a new high, range, volume or a gap.
rules: Matches on ANY one of the nine — not all of them
Up 20%+ over a week, or 25%+ over a month, or 35%+ over a quarter, or 50%+ over six months
Or ADR above 6%, or volume at 3× the 20-day average
Or gapped up 5%+ today, or closed up 6%+

name: Relative Strength Leaders
description: Beat the Nifty by 15 points over a quarter and still near the high.
rules: Outperformed NIFTY 50 by 15 percentage points over 60 days

name: RS Line at New High
description: Relative strength already at a new high while price still lags.
rules: RS line versus NIFTY 50 at its 60-day high
Price still at least 2% below its own 60-day high

name: Stage 2 Uptrend
description: The classic trend template: well off the low, close to the high.

name: Momentum Burst
description: An 8% three-day thrust on heavy volume, in a name that moves.

name: Quiet Strength
description: Outperforming without the volatility — a low-noise uptrend.
rules: Beat NIFTY 50 by 5 points over 60 days

name: 52-Week High Breakout
description: A yearly high printed today, confirmed by volume.
rules: Highest high of the last 252 sessions

name: 20-Day High on Record Volume
description: A one-month high on the heaviest volume of the month.
rules: Highest high of the last 20 sessions
Highest volume of the last 20 sessions

name: Breakout from Tight Base
description: Three quiet weeks, then a high on double volume.
rules: The 20 days before today traded in under 7% of price
Highest high of the last 20 sessions

name: Pocket Pivot
description: A modest up day on outsized volume, inside an existing uptrend.

name: ADX Trend Breakout
description: A quarterly high with the trend strength to back it.
rules: Highest high of the last 50 sessions

name: Circuit-Safe Breakout
description: A breakout that will not lock at the upper limit before you can act.
rules: Highest high of the last 60 sessions

name: VCP Contraction
description: The range halved against its own base while volume dried up.
rules: Last 10 days traded in half the range of the 60 days before them

name: Inside Bar Coil
description: Two straight inside days inside an uptrend.

name: Weekly Inside Bar
description: The current ISO week to date remains inside the prior completed week, while price stays near its 52-week high.
rules: Current ISO week to date inside the prior completed week

name: Volume Dry-Up Base
description: Sellers finished: volume at 60% of normal in a narrow range.

name: Flat Base
description: Six weeks sideways within 10%, right under the high.

name: Horizontal Resistance
description: Pressing a ceiling it has been rejected from, not yet closed above.
rules: A confirmed swing-high pivot in the last 252 sessions
No close since has exceeded it — wicks through are fine, a close above is not
Base at least 15 days old — excludes freshly-formed, low-confidence pivots
Latest close within 5% of the line — still pressing it, not fallen away
Latest close within 2% of its own 20 EMA — not extended, not falling away from trend

name: Flags & Pennants
description: A sharp pole, then a tight drift that refuses to give it back.
rules: Up at least 20% over 30 days — the pole
Last 7 days under half the range of the 25 days before them — the flag
Volume in the last 5 days below 80% of the prior 25

name: Low-ATR Coil
description: Volatility at a floor — a tight stop is actually possible here.

name: 21 EMA Pullback
description: Dipped under the 21 EMA and closed straight back above it.
rules: Lost the 21 EMA within the last 3 days and reclaimed it
Beat NIFTY 50 by 5 points over 60 days

name: 50 EMA Shakeout
description: A deeper flush through the 50 EMA that failed within the week.
rules: Lost the 50 EMA within the last 5 days and reclaimed it

name: Higher-Low Pullback
description: A 4%+ two-week dip inside a trend that never broke.

name: Gap Support Retest
description: An open gap below acting as the floor for the current move.
rules: An unfilled 3%+ gap up in the last 30 days

name: Volume Surge
description: Twice the average volume on a 2% up day.

name: Highest Volume in 3 Months
description: The heaviest session of the quarter, and it closed green.
rules: Highest volume of the last 60 sessions

name: Delivery-Backed Accumulation
description: Heavy volume that actually settled as delivery, not day trades.

name: Sustained Accumulation
description: Two weeks of elevated volume, not one loud day.

name: Unfilled Gap Up
description: A 4%+ gap the market never came back to fill.
rules: An unfilled 4%+ gap up in the last 60 days

name: Gap & Go
description: Today's 3% gap up came with the volume to hold it.

name: Gap Down Washout
description: A capitulation gap into the yearly low, in a liquid name.

name: 52-Week Low Bounce
description: A volume-backed 5% pop straight off the yearly low.

name: RS Divergence Turn
description: Deep off the high, yet quietly beating the index again.
rules: Beat NIFTY 50 over the last 60 days
Still more than 30% below the 52-week high

name: Relative Weakness
description: Lagging the index by 15 points and printing new lows.
rules: Underperformed NIFTY 50 by 15 points over 60 days
Lowest low of the last 60 sessions

name: Earnings Growth Momentum
description: 25% profit growth with the chart already agreeing.
rules: Net profit up more than 25% year on year

name: Post-Earnings Drift
description: Results landed this week and the market is still repricing.
rules: Results announced within the last 5 sessions

name: Growth at a Fair Price
description: 20% growth still on a sub-30 trailing multiple.
rules: Net profit up more than 20% year on year

name: Revenue & Profit Acceleration
description: Both lines growing 20%+, in a name already trending.
rules: Revenue up more than 20% year on year
Net profit up more than 20% year on year

name: Pre-Earnings Coil
description: Tight and quiet with no result for two months — a catalyst is due.
rules: No results for at least 60 sessions

name: Breadth-Gated Leaders
description: Momentum names, but only on days the market is actually healthy.
rules: More than half the market above its 50-day average
Held above the 10, 20 or 50 EMA for weeks

name: Liquid Trading Universe
description: A clean working universe: real turnover, no ₹20 names, no T2T.

name: Fresh IPO Base
description: A recent listing building its first real base.

name: Nifty 500 Momentum
description: Index-member leaders only — nothing off the beaten track.
rules: Beat NIFTY 50 by 10 points over 60 days

name: Midcap Breakout
description: The ₹2,000–20,000 Cr band, breaking to a quarterly high.
rules: Highest high of the last 60 sessions

name: VCP (Volatility Contraction)
description: Successively shallower contractions with volume dry-up near highs.
rules: Within 15% of 52-week high and above 50 DMA

name: Darvas Box (Confirmed / Breakout)
description: Box ceiling within 5% of 52W high, height <= 20%, 3-day hold for top and bottom.

name: Cup with Handle
description: Base depth 12-40% over >= 7 weeks, handle pullback in upper half <= 12%.
rules: Right rim within 12% of left rim

name: Bull Flag / Pennant
description: Sharp run-up >= 25% into a high 4-20 sessions ago, shallow pullback <= 12%.
rules: Flag pole run-up >= 25% reached 4-20 sessions ago

name: Pocket Pivot
description: Up day above 50 DMA whose volume exceeds every down-day volume in the preceding 10 sessions.
rules: Close > prior close and above 50 DMA
Volume exceeds maximum down-day volume in last 10 days

name: Volume Breakout (50-Day)
description: Close above prior 50-day high (excluding today) with relative volume >= 2x.
rules: Latest close clears the prior 50-day high (excluding today)

name: Multi-Year Breakout
description: Clearing ~3-year resistance ceiling that held for at least 1 year, within 15% of breakout level.
rules: Clears multi-year resistance ceiling held for >= 1 year

name: Coiled Spring
description: 10-day range <= 10%, ATR(10)/ATR(50) <= 0.85, volume-dry ratio < 0.90, RS >= 60.

name: Tight Weeks
description: At least 3 consecutive weekly closes within 1.5% of one another, above 50 DMA, RS >= 60.
rules: >= 3 consecutive weekly closes within 1.5% of each other

name: Minervini Trend Template (8/8 Leaders)
description: Passes all 8 strict trend rules: Price > 150/200, 150 > 200, 200 rising, 50 > 150/200, +30% off low, within 25% of high, RS >= 70.

name: Stage 2 Uptrend (Weinstein)
description: SMA150 slope rose more than 1.0% over 20 sessions with price above it.

name: Just Entered Stage 2
description: Currently in Stage 2, but was NOT in Stage 2 15 sessions ago (fresh transition).
rules: Was not in Stage 2 15 sessions ago

name: RS Line at 52-Week High
description: Stock / Nifty 500 relative strength ratio at a new 52-week high.
rules: Stock to Nifty 500 ratio at highest level in 52 weeks

name: RS Leaders (>= 80)
description: Composite RS Rating in top 20% of universe (RS >= 80).

name: Upcoming Results (Next 7 Days)
description: Scheduled corporate earnings result within the next 7 calendar days.
rules: Earnings results date within next 7 days

name: Upcoming Results (Next 14 Days)
description: Scheduled corporate earnings result within the next 14 calendar days.
rules: Earnings results date within next 14 days
